overview.description: Okey is the quintessential social game of Turkey, a tile-based Rummy variant played with 106 wooden or plastic tiles numbered 1-13 in four colors. A face-up indicator tile determines which tiles act as wild jokers. Players draw and discard to form sets and runs; the first to complete a valid 14-tile hand wins the round. Ubiquitous in Turkish kahvehanes (coffee houses).
overview.deck: 106 tiles (1-13 in four colors, 8 each; 2 false jokers)

history.origins: Derived from 19th-century tile games of the Levant and Central Asia, sharing ancestry with Rummikub and Mahjong. Rules stabilised in Ottoman Turkey.
timeline: 1900s: Traditional Okey rules crystallise in Ottoman social circles.
1930s: Custom-painted wooden tiles become a standard luxury item.
1970s: Plastic sets make the game accessible to every Turkish household.
Present: National pastime of Turkey; played in kahvehanes and online by millions daily.

setup.players: 4 players (2-3 possible). Each uses a rack (Istaka).
setup.deck: 106 tiles: numbers 1-13 in red, yellow, green, black (8 per number); 2 unmarked false jokers. One 6-sided die.
setup.dealing: Tiles mixed face-down, stacked in 21 piles of 5. Dealer throws die twice to select indicator tile. Player to dealer's right gets 15 tiles, others 14. Play proceeds anticlockwise.

rules.objective: Be the first to form a winning hand of 14 tilesâ€”all in valid sets and runsâ€”and expose it after your discard.
rules.gameplay: 1. Indicator tile determines joker: the tile of same color and one number higher (e.g. Green 10 face-up â†’ Green 11s are jokers). False jokers represent only that joker tile. 2. If a player holds the matching indicator tile, they may show it (gÃ¶sterme) for 1 point from each opponent before play. 3. Player to dealer's right discards first. 4. Each turn: draw one tile (from centre or previous player's discard) and discard one. 5. No melding until the end; first to complete a valid hand exposes it and wins. 6. Winning hand: 14 tiles in sets (3-4 same number, different colors) and/or runs (3+ consecutive same color; 1 may follow 13). Alternative: seven identical pairs. 7. Winning by discarding the joker doubles opponents' point loss.
keyRules: Joker = same color, one number higher than indicator. False jokers = only that joker tile.
Seven pairs: each pair must be identical (same color and number).
GÃ¶sterme: show matching indicator at start for 1 point from each opponent; only before first draw.
Joker-discard win: opponents lose 4 each (vs 2 for ordinary win).

strategy.basic: Prioritise runs over groups; runs extend both ends. Don't hoard the indicator tile unless it completes a set. Showing it (gÃ¶sterme) at start gives a free point but reveals information.
strategy.intermediate: The discard trap: taking from the bank instead of an opponent's discard can hide your hand. Sometimes 'fishing' from the bank is better than signalling by taking their discard.
strategy.advanced: Never discard the joker unless forced. Winning by discarding the joker doubles point loss. Track discardsâ€”if three 10s of a color are gone, that 10 is useless for a group. Joker preservation is key; use it to complete a 4-tile group or bridge a gap in a run.
tips: The false joker always equals the current round's joker tile.
Watch discard piles you're allowed to see (yours and to your left).

draw.description: Draw one tile from the stock or take the previous player's discard.
draw.constraints: At start of turn; must draw before discarding. Can take from stock (face-down) or the discard just made by the player to your right. First player (right of dealer) does not draw; they discard only.

discard.description: Discard one tile face up to your discard pile.
discard.constraints: After drawing (or as first player, without drawing); exactly one tile per turn. Placed to your right; only the top of your discard stack is visible to others.

go_out.description: Expose your 14-tile winning hand and end the round.
go_out.constraints: Only when hand is valid: all 14 tiles in sets and/or runs, or seven identical pairs. You expose after your discard. Joker-discard win doubles opponents' point loss.

goingOut.condition: All 14 tiles in valid sets and/or runs, or seven identical pairs; expose after discard.

edgeCases.text: First player to act (right of dealer) discards one tile without drawing.
When no tiles left to draw and current player cannot win by taking the previous discard, the round ends with no score.

engine.handRankingSystem: Sets (3-4 same number, different colours) and runs (3+ consecutive same colour; 1 may follow 13). Seven identical pairs is an alternative winning hand. Joker substitutes for any tile in sets and runs.
engine.deckDescription: 106 wooden or plastic tiles; numbers 1-13 in four colors (red, yellow, green, black), 8 of each number; 2 unmarked false jokers.
engine.suitDescription: Four colour groups (suits) are used: red, yellow, green, and black. Each numbered tile belongs to one of these colours; the two false joker tiles have no number and are used to represent the current round's joker value.
engine.rankDescription: Each colour has tiles numbered 1 through 13, with two copies of each number per colour (104 numbered tiles total). The two false joker tiles have no printed number; each round one number in one colour is designated the joker and can substitute for any tile.
engine.dealPattern: Player to dealer's right receives 15 tiles; other players receive 14 each. Stacks distributed anticlockwise from the stack after the indicator stack; one player gets an extra tile from the next stack.

synthesis.shortDescription: Turkish tile Rummy with 106 tiles, indicator-determined jokers, and race to complete a 14-tile hand. The quintessential kahvehane game.

prompts.human: Draw one, discard one. Build sets and runs. The tile one number higher than the face-up indicator is wild. First to finish wins. Show the matching indicator at start for a free point (gÃ¶sterme).
prompts.ai: Game: Okey Turkish. 106 tiles, 14 per player. Joker = indicator+1 same color. False jokers = joker only. Sets: 3-4 same number diff colors. Runs: 3+ consecutive same color. Seven pairs alternate win. GÃ¶sterme: 1pt each. Score: start 20, lose 2/4 per opponent win.

scoring.description: Each player starts with 20 points. Losing points when opponents win.
scoring.winCondition: Play continues until any player reaches 0 or below. The two players with the highest scores are winners; the two with lowest are losers.

nullReasons.cardValues: Scoring is by point loss per round (2 or 4 per opponent); no per-tile card values.
nullReasons.targetScore: Players start at 20 and lose points; game ends when any player reaches 0 or below (no target score to reach).
